title: Aikido Security reports 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face Spaces, 29 linked to DeepSite
date_note: Cyber Security News gives only its own publication day for the report; Aikido's page was not read.
summary: Cyber Security News reports that Aikido Security found 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face Spaces impersonating 28 brands, including Microsoft, Google, PayPal, Chase and Coinbase. According to Aikido, 29 pages were linked to the DeepSite AI website builder. The article says Aikido reported them on October 16 and that by October 29 all 42 were paused or no longer publicly reachable.
plain: Cyber Security News says Aikido Security found 42 fake sign-in pages hosted on Hugging Face Spaces, 29 linked to the DeepSite AI builder. By October 29 all 42 were paused or unreachable, per the article.
exec: Per Cyber Security News, Aikido found 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face Spaces impersonating 28 brands; all 42 were paused or unreachable by October 29.
action: Cyber Security News's article advises searching DNS, proxy, firewall and email gateway logs for the hostnames, resetting the password and revoking sessions if credentials may have been submitted, and opening services from a saved bookmark.
geo_basis: No victim or attacker location stated in the article; placeholder at the centre of the US

evidence.quote: Aikido Security identified 42 pages on Hugging Face Spaces that impersonated 28 brands
Researchers linked 29 of the pages to DeepSite.
By October 29, all 42 were paused or no longer publicly reachable.

validation.note: Only Cyber Security News read; Aikido's own report and any Hugging Face statement were not found.
